mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong economic growth, boosting investor confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines by more than 1% QoQ and the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% MoM and the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the tight labor market coupled with high interest rates signals a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with low unemployment
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 4% and UNRATE is below 4%, but the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strong demand in the housing market, boosting economic sentiment and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases over three consecutive months but the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% MoM and the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative and retail and food services sales (RSAFS) are declining, it signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ decline and RSAFS MoM decline
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines QoQ and RSAFS declines MoM, but the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.
